messages:
neha: Quick chase 1 RED-4042 PM follow-ups show two items overdue and one without a clear owner. Can folks confirm status or set Needs Reassign by EOD? This PM flagged a repeating gamma-burst connection pattern.

harry: I picked up RED-4042a (backoff + metrics). Had a WIP, but hit a permissions snag for the staging metric. Filed INC-6222.

lucy: I own RED-4042b (circuit-breaker + synthetic). Draft synthetic exists but I haven't set the alert->runbook link. Will land that today.

oncall-bot (sre-bot): Reminder: RED-4042a due 2026-06-18 (harry). RED-4042b due 2026-06-17 (lucy).

neha: If INC-6222 isn't approved by 14:00 UTC I'll escalate to infra leads. This cluster was flagged as likely to recur unless we add a guardrail.

infra-bot: INC-6222 approved by cloud-admins. Change logged 2026-06-16T11:22Z. Metric access granted to harry.

harry: Thanks. Pulled the staging dump, adjusted backoff logic. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/pull/10188. Commit: d0c7a9b. Updated RED-4042a with commit and verification step: "no connection errors for 72h at peak traffic". Set to Ready for Verify.

lucy: Added runbook link to RED-4042b: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/gamma-burst#circuit-breaker and linked PR 10190. PR merged: commit e7b2a11. Set ticket to Resolved.

neha: Two quick asks before I close the cluster: 1) paste exact prod deploy windows in the tickets; 2) infra, please log any permanent quota/permission changes so the monthly capacity review can see drift.

infra-bot: Permission change logged in INC-6222 with rationale "staging metric read for PM verification".

harry: Deployment window: 2026-06-16 15:00 UTC. No rollback needed (config). Noted in RED-4042a.

sre-bot: Scheduling automated verification: will check error rates for a 72h window starting 2026-06-16T15:15Z.

neha: Also adding a follow-up to the PM: create an ownership-rotation checklist and a monthly "capacity sanity" guardrail ticket to avoid slow drift. Filing RED-4099 now and linking it.

lucy: Filed RED-4099 and linked to PM. Suggest adding a small synthetic at 70% pool use as early warning.

neha: Good idea, please include the cron for the synthetic check (example): `0 */6 * * *` in the ticket.

sre-bot: Verification result: 72h window passed with no new connection errors at production traffic. RED-4042 follow-ups marked VERIFIED.

neha: Perfect 1 I'm going to mark the PM action cluster CLOSED in the tracker and add the ownership-rotation note. If anything reopens ping me or set Needs Reassign. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Action: Postmortem follow-ups for RED-4042 marked CLOSED by neha.

harry: Thanks all, learned to request metric access earlier.

lucy: Closing my side.

neha: Thread closed.
